Step-by-step re-check:

Formula: Profit = Revenue - Variable Cost - Fixed Cost
= Price * Q_sold - $12 * Q_produced - $12,000

Constraints: Q_produced <= 900 capacity, Q_sold <= Q_demand, Q_sold <= Q_produced. Unmet demand lost.

Since Price - $12 > 0 for all options, optimal Q_produced = Q_sold = min(Q_demand, 900).
So Profit = (Price - 12) * min(demand,900) - 12000.

Recompute:
- $19: margin = 19-12 = 7. Q = min(2084,900)=900. 7*900=6300. 6300-12000 = -5700
- $24: margin = 24-12 = 12. Q = min(1164,900)=900. 12*900=10800. 10800-12000 = -1200
- $29: margin = 29-12 = 17. Q = min(949,900)=900. 17*900=15300. 15300-12000 = 3300
- $34: margin = 34-12 = 22. Q = min(524,900)=524. 22*524 = 11528. 11528-12000 = -472
- $39: margin = 39-12 = 27. Q = min(120,900)=120. 27*120=3240. 3240-12000 = -8760

All numbers verified. Maximum is $29 with $3,300 profit.
